ash: Heads-up, preflight eval on the summarizer suite just flagged a ~6% drop in ROUGE-L for release 2026.04. Not sure if it's noisy or real. deploy-bot: Preflight results: 6.1% delta ROUGE-L, 0.4% BLEU, p-value=0.02. Canary run used quantized-v2. maria: wow that's above our soft threshold (>=5%). we should not promote without triage. kevin: Agree. Can we isolate by region/model variant? Maybe route EU to previous model while we debug. lee: If we do regional rollback, we should also shift change window to avoid mid-day traffic. suggest +2h. ash: What does deploy-bot recommend for automated gating? deploy-bot: Gate rules triggered: stop_promotion. Suggested actions: 1) hold rollout 2) optional region pin 3) re-run prompt-eval with full seeds. qa-runner: I'll kick off a full eval sweep and attach logs, ETA ~45m. kevin: If QA confirms, we can either pin 2026.03 for eu-west-1 or do a canary rollback for 10% of traffic. leaning to pin to be safe. maria: pin + schedule shift sounds safest. ash: propose: 1) delay release by 2 hours 2) pin eu-west-1 to model: rwd/summarizer-2026.03 3) re-run eval and reconvene. everyone ok? lee: +1, please add rollback runbook note. kevin: +1. maria: +1 :thumbsup: deploy-bot: executing region pin command: ```
redwood rollout set --model rwd/summarizer-2026.03 --region eu-west-1 --traffic 100 --until 2026-04-12T14:00:00Z
``` ash: Created ticket REL-1429 with summary, assigned to qa and infra, added links to eval artifacts. qa-runner: full sweep started: https://ci.internal/rel-1429/eval-logs. will update in ~45m. maria: thanks — once we have QA green, we can decide to re-open the window or proceed with a staggered canary. kevin: also adding a temporary alert rule to watch ROUGE-L in realtime for the next 24h. lee: noted, I'll draft the release notes addendum about the regional pin and expected behavior. ash: ok locking plan: delay 2h, pin EU, QA sweep, reconvene on thread. thanks all.
